tagline: Your skills and agents, one click from the prompt

features.title: Skills and agents
features.detail: Lists your skills and agents, personal and the open project's, grouped under tags. A click adds one to the prompt.

features.title: Color tags
features.detail: Give a skill a `color-tag: <tag>` line in its SKILL.md frontmatter to group it under that tag and badge it in the slash typeahead. The tags are router, start, debug, review, interface, writing, utility and mods; a skill without one, or with another name, lands under personal.
